Hi! About 4 weeks ago I decided to do an experiment and gave up on using artificial lights at home except my phone with low luminosity and the blue filter on. At first it didnt do any effect at all but then I started to want to sleep more early like 11pm-12am in contrast to 2am-3am that I used to

Now I‘m trying to find some alternatives to the doomscrolling on my phone and for the daytime part its fine as I‘ve got a lot of things to do but when it gets dark and I cannot do anything I just glue myself to the screen because I don‘t know what else I can do when it's dark. Any suggestions?

Also I want to add that I have ADHD and I need constant stimulation (not in the sense of being addicted to fastfood, watching reels, etc. but in the general sense of being stimulated, I mean things like walking thinking or chewing a gum work just fine too) so things like meditate or do some yoga don't work for me and please don't tell me how boredom is the best teacher

Thanks!
